## Load libraries

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(vcfR)
```

## Input files and filter settings

The upstream processing was performed with PeifLyne v0.7.0 using GRCh37/hg19.
This document contains only the post-processing of somatic SNVs and small
InDels. 

```{r input}
# Define paths relative to the analysis directory.
sample_file <- "lists/samples_orange.txt"
vcf_directory <- "snv/peiflyne/mutcall_filtered"
vep_file <- "snv/vep_alphamissense/muts_pass_am_gnomad_most_severe_variants.vcf"
microsec_directory <- "microsec/output"
output_file <- "results/snv_indels/reproducible/snv_indel_per_sample.csv"

write_outputs <- TRUE

sample_list <- read_lines(sample_file)

minimum_vaf <- 0.10
maximum_gnomad_af <- 0.01
maximum_cohort_frequency <- 0.05
maximum_variants_per_gene <- 2L

hotspot_genes <- c("NSD2", "TP53", "ATM", "MEF2B", "SMARCA4")

stopifnot(length(sample_list) == 181L)
```

## Helper functions

```{r functions}
normalize_chromosome <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  if_else(str_starts(x, "chr"), x, paste0("chr", x))
}

normalize_gene_symbol <- function(x) {
  recode(as.character(x), WHSC1 = "NSD2")
}

# Read PASS variants from one PeifLyne VCF.
read_mutations <- function(sample_id) {
  file <- file.path(
    vcf_directory,
    paste0(sample_id, "_mutcall_filtered.vcf")
  )

  vcf <- read.vcfR(file, verbose = FALSE)
  fixed <- as_tibble(vcf@fix, .name_repair = "minimal")
  info <- extract_info_tidy(
    vcf,
    info_fields = c("DP", "DP_N", "AF", "AF_N", "FR", "TG")
  )

  bind_cols(fixed, info) %>%
    transmute(
      sample_id = as.character(sample_id),
      CHROM = normalize_chromosome(CHROM),
      POS = as.integer(POS),
      ID = na_if(as.character(ID), "."),
      REF = as.character(REF),
      ALT = as.character(ALT),
      QUAL = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(QUAL)),
      FILTER = as.character(FILTER),
      AF = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(AF)),
      DP = as.integer(DP),
      AF_N = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(AF_N)),
      DP_N = as.integer(DP_N),
      FR = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(FR)),
      TG = as.character(TG)
    ) %>%
    # Keep the residual dbSNP-ID screen used in the source analysis.
    filter(FILTER == "PASS", is.na(ID)) %>%
    distinct(sample_id, CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# Read the VEP v110, gnomAD v2.1, and AlphaMissense annotations.
read_vep_annotation <- function(file) {
  vcf <- read.vcfR(file, verbose = FALSE)
  fixed <- as_tibble(vcf@fix, .name_repair = "minimal")
  csq <- extract_info_tidy(vcf, info_fields = "CSQ")$CSQ

  csq_names <- c(
    "Consequence", "Biotype", "Impact", "Existing_variation", "Codons",
    "Amino_acids", "Gene", "Symbol", "Feature", "EXON", "INTRON",
    "Protein_position", "Allele", "am_pathogenicity", "am_class",
    "gnomADe_AF", "gnomADe_NFE_AF", "HGVSc", "HGVSp"
  )

  bind_cols(fixed, tibble(CSQ = csq)) %>%
    transmute(
      CHROM = normalize_chromosome(CHROM),
      POS = as.integer(POS),
      REF = as.character(REF),
      ALT = as.character(ALT),
      CSQ
    ) %>%
    separate_rows(CSQ, sep = ",") %>%
    separate(
      CSQ,
      into = csq_names,
      sep = "\\|",
      fill = "right",
      extra = "merge"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(all_of(csq_names), ~ na_if(.x, "")),
      gene_symbol = normalize_gene_symbol(Symbol),
      am_pathogenicity = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(am_pathogenicity)),
      gnomADe_AF = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gnomADe_AF)),
      gnomADe_NFE_AF = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gnomADe_NFE_AF))
    ) %>%
    distinct(CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

# Read MicroSEC classifications for all retained samples.
read_microsec <- function(samples) {
  map_dfr(samples, function(sample_id) {
    read_tsv(
      file.path(
        microsec_directory,
        paste0("MicroSEC_", sample_id, ".tsv")
      ),
      col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
      progress = FALSE
    ) %>%
      select(Sample, Chr, Pos, Ref, Alt, msec_filter_all)
  }) %>%
    transmute(
      sample_id = as.character(Sample),
      CHROM = normalize_chromosome(Chr),
      POS = as.integer(Pos),
      REF = as.character(Ref),
      ALT = as.character(Alt),
      microsec_result = msec_filter_all,
      microsec_artifact = str_detect(
        coalesce(msec_filter_all, ""),
        fixed("Artifact suspicious")
      )
    ) %>%
    distinct(sample_id, CHROM, POS, REF, ALT, .keep_all = TRUE)
}
```

## Read and annotate mutations

```{r read-mutations}
muts <- map_dfr(sample_list, read_mutations)
vep <- read_vep_annotation(vep_file)
microsec <- read_microsec(sample_list)

muts_annotated <- muts %>%
  left_join(
    vep,
    by = c("CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    microsec,
    by = c("sample_id", "CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT"),
    relationship = "many-to-one"
  )
```

## Filter mutations

```{r filter-mutations}
retained_consequences <- c(
  "transcript_ablation",
  "splice_acceptor_variant",
  "splice_donor_variant",
  "stop_gained",
  "frameshift_variant",
  "stop_lost",
  "start_lost",
  "transcript_amplification",
  "inframe_insertion",
  "inframe_deletion",
  "missense_variant",
  "protein_altering_variant"
)

final_mut_matrix_per_sample <- muts_annotated %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Consequence),
    !is.na(gene_symbol),
    Biotype %in% c("protein_coding", "nonsense_mediated_decay")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    map_lgl(
      str_split(Consequence, fixed("&")),
      ~ any(.x %in% retained_consequences)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(is.na(gnomADe_AF) | gnomADe_AF < maximum_gnomad_af) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AF), AF > minimum_vaf) %>%
  filter(!coalesce(microsec_artifact, FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(CHROM, POS, REF, ALT) %>%
  mutate(
    cohort_frequency = n_distinct(sample_id) / length(sample_list)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    cohort_frequency < maximum_cohort_frequency |
      gene_symbol %in% hotspot_genes
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_id, gene_symbol) %>%
  mutate(variants_in_gene = n_distinct(paste(CHROM, POS, REF, ALT))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    variants_in_gene <= maximum_variants_per_gene |
      gene_symbol %in% hotspot_genes
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variant_class = if_else(
      nchar(REF) == 1L & nchar(ALT) == 1L,
      "SNV",
      "indel"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(sample_id, CHROM, POS, REF, ALT)
```

## Check and export results

```{r check-results}
stopifnot(
  !anyDuplicated(
    final_mut_matrix_per_sample[c("sample_id", "CHROM", "POS", "REF", "ALT")]
  ),
  all(final_mut_matrix_per_sample$AF > minimum_vaf),
  all(
    is.na(final_mut_matrix_per_sample$gnomADe_AF) |
      final_mut_matrix_per_sample$gnomADe_AF < maximum_gnomad_af
  ),
  !any(final_mut_matrix_per_sample$microsec_artifact, na.rm = TRUE)
)

result_summary <- final_mut_matrix_per_sample %>%
  summarise(
    samples = n_distinct(sample_id),
    mutations = n(),
    SNVs = sum(variant_class == "SNV"),
    indels = sum(variant_class == "indel")
  )

result_summary
```

```{r write-results}
if (write_outputs) {
  dir.create(dirname(output_file), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  write_csv(final_mut_matrix_per_sample, output_file)
}
```
